adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: `GroupsController#members` sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and returns it in `meta.limit` unvalidated, so a client can send `limit=0` and server will echo `meta.limit: 0`. In `group.js#findMembers`, the model then persists `limit: result.meta.limit`. In `admin-group.js.es6`, `currentPage` and `totalPages` compute `Math.floor(... / this.get("limit"))`, so with `limit === 0` this yields `Infinity`/`NaN`, breaking pagination state for that model instance. This edge case is introduced/exposed by the new pagination/meta plumbing in the diff.
